title: A Note on n-Representations of Simplicial Groups
summary: For $n\ge1$, we study representations of a simplicial group $G$ in the full $\infty$-subcategory of simplicial vector spaces whose normalized homology is concentrated in degrees $0,\ldots,n-1$, retaining its full mapping spaces. The resulting functor category depends only on the $n$-truncated homotopy type of $\mathbf{B}G$ and admits projectively bifibrant strict diagram and simplicial group-algebra module models.
